Rollback and verification SQL should live in `supabase/rollback` and `supabase/verify`, not in the migration replay path.

## Recommended Reconciliation Strategy

1. Keep the verified schema baseline as the current source-of-truth artifact for understanding production shape.
2. Do not try to make every historical migration replayable one-by-one; several assume production objects or mutate old function bodies.
3. Create a new baseline migration chain for future development, with old migrations archived outside the replay path.
4. Preserve historical SQL under an archive/review directory so definitions remain searchable.
5. From the baseline forward, require one forward migration, one rollback, and one verifier per change.
6. Use Supabase branch restores and advisor checks to test cleanup batches before production.
